row.title: Text-form tenants re-vendor file by file from their recorded core paths (US-31-R63)
row.body: A diff review of the round-2 landing found that tenant_sync.py revendor compared a text-form VENDORED_FROM (keys inside the vendor directory) with the workers selection (keys relative to workers/), so on a text-form tenant it would have deleted the vendored files and written the whole workers tree in their place. revendor and send-up now resolve each vendored file through core_sources: the JSON form keeps the whole selection, the text form takes exactly the listed files from each recorded core path under the repository root, removes nothing and reports a vanished core path as missing_in_core, which keeps the tenant out of in-sync. The same review tightened four guards: spec_ids fails two same-form definitions of one ID in one file, vendor.py --check and tenant_sync check report unreadable record lines and hashless files, heldByComment holds a pull request as HOLD unread when a later comment page cannot be read after a full first page, and connector callback refusals are written once per tenant, provider and reason kind an hour. The reference vault binds each sealed value to its name. actions-budget.json was restored to the minute budget and kill switch that ten consumers read, after executor PR #2661 had replaced it with a document nothing reads. Evidence: node --test tools/spec-31-vendor.test.mjs from workers/ (8 pass), seed Worker tests (1124 pass, 0 fail), every foundation test file and named check passing.
